comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
Shirin just exhibit something at the Louvre (as it's been pointed out already) and theres a small chance a trend will start in your home city based on the culture area your exhibit came from. I did find the game factors in the following:

Cultural contribution - higher ranking means better chance of trend starting
Trendsetter title - Im not sure how you acquire this, but it increases the odds too.
Large hall - Putting exhibits in the large hall rather then the smaller ones helps the odds.

I cant confirm this but supposedly if other players of your nation exhibits an artifact from the same culture area (North Africa, SE asia, etc) that might boost the odds of a trend starting in your capital too.

comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body:
To add on Hans' explanation: Trendsetter title is gained when you trigger your first cultural trend outbreak. Lorenzo de'Medici (the NPC from Florence) will want to meet with you in the Paris museum. After a short conversation with him, he grants you the title of Trendsetter (can be changed into at any time from your other titles), as well as these two items:

Trendsetter's Hat
Trendsetter's Dress

By the way, I triggered my first cultural trend (and netted the title/eq) from displaying in my country's small gallery with a 4-star display. Just keep trying, and eventually, you'll get it.
